features: Fixed — A BALANCE RECORDED AFTER ISSUING BECAME IMPOSSIBLE TO CHARGE. The instalment-plan creation screen decided whether to offer carried-over balances by reading the management flag, which since beta.32 is a derived value: it turns on as soon as ONE row is locked. So the first issued plan was enough for the system to answer «carried-over balances have already been integrated» and offer nothing further — including rows added afterwards, which beta.33 had made recordable precisely to allow mid-year corrections. You could write that amount down, but never ask anyone for it again. The refusal now appears only when there really are no free balances, and it says what to do.

Fixed: a debt owed to a supplier was counted among the balances available for absorption and shown to the administrator, even though it can never enter an instalment plan. The figure displayed was not the one the plan would actually charge.

Every list in the management area now has an empty state with an icon and an explanation: units, thousandth tables, managements and charts of accounts are joined by cash accounts, financial years, blocks, staircases, people and unit documents.

No database changes in this version, not even one migration. Three planned items that would have required one were postponed to 1.11: the 1.9.1 → 1.10 path is the only upgrade without an automatic backup, and none of those three fixes a defect users are suffering today.

New — SUPPLIER INVOICES GUIDE IN THE PAGE HEADER. What belongs in this list and what does not (an immediate adjustment creates no invoice: it lives in the Journal), how to read a row, budget overruns and assembly ratification, the seven reasons Delete can be blocked with the remedy for each, and fund coverage. It includes something that was written nowhere: reversal is reversible — delete the credit note it generates and the original invoice returns to the state computed from actual payments.

In the supplier invoices list, withholding tax was flagged by a 6-pixel cyan dot explained only on hover. It is now a readable «Ritenuta» badge, identical to the one already used in Supplier payments: the same information now looks the same on both pages.
In the invoice row menu the entries that explain a ban («Delete — not allowed», «Reverse — payments first») wrapped onto two lines. The menu has been widened.

Fixed — THE PAYMENT NOTICE ADDED UP CARRIED-OVER BALANCES FROM EVERY MANAGEMENT. The «Opening balance» line was computed by filtering on financial year and building without naming the management: with an ordinary and an extraordinary management open in the same year, one notice also reported the other's carried-over amount (€800.00 printed instead of €300.00 in the measured case). The opposite direction was worse: a credit on another management lowered the amount due, and a figure that is too low never gets questioned. The accounts were never wrong; the sheet handed to the owner was.

Fixed — THE «DELETE» BAN ON SUPPLIER INVOICES IS NO LONGER SILENT. The server refuses deletion for seven distinct reasons (confirmed reserve-fund coverage, instalment plan with issued or collected instalments, approved plan, paid or partly paid invoice, several linked journal entries, closed financial year, already-reversed invoice). The row menu checked two of them, and when the condition was false it simply removed the entry with no explanation. The reverse could also happen: the entry shown, the operation then refused. The entry now always stays visible — disabled when it cannot be used — with the reason and the remedy in the tooltip.
The reason for the ban is computed server-side and travels with the invoice: the menu and the deletion guard are the same rule, so they can no longer say different things.

New — OPENING BALANCES GUIDE IN THE PAGE HEADER. The Balances page now has its own «Guide» button, like the settings and thousandth-table pages. It explains what you record here, why the sign is chosen by the button rather than by typing a minus, the difference between a balance assigned to the whole unit and to a specific person, how balances enter an instalment plan, and above all the padlock: who closes it, when it snaps shut, why it applies to the single row, and how it reopens. Including the three ways to correct a balance that is already locked.

Fixed — YOU COULD NOT SWITCH BUILDING FROM THE BALANCES PAGE. It was the only page in the Structure section where the building name stayed fixed text instead of the selector available everywhere else. Switching to another building meant leaving the page and coming back.

EMPTY LISTS NOW HAVE AN ICON AND AN EXPLANATION. The lists of units, thousandth tables, managements and charts of accounts showed a terse «No results found» in the middle of an empty table. When nothing has been created yet they now show a panel with an icon, a title and what is needed to get started.

Those same lists now tell «nothing exists yet» apart from «the search returned nothing»: both used to produce the same message, so anyone searching for a name that did not exist was invited to create the first record as if the building were empty. In the second case the search term is repeated and the hint is to clear the filter.
